name: HMND 01 Alpha
dof_breakdown: 29 active DOF excluding end effectors; swappable 12-DOF five-finger hand or 1-DOF parallel gripper
summary: London's entry in the industrial humanoid race, developed in about seven months and offered as robotics-as-a-service rather than sold. It comes in two bodies on one architecture: a wheeled 220 cm mobile manipulator for warehouse picking, and this bipedal Alpha, which the company says walked stably within 48 hours of final assembly.
notable: Bipedal Alpha walked 48 hours after final assembly
Swappable dexterous hand or parallel gripper
